responsibility: This Python documentation generator converts GNU Modula-2 definition modules into library reference manuals in either Texinfo or Sphinx/reStructuredText form. It classifies library directories, emits menu/node/section structure for groups of modules, reads .def files from source and build trees, strips or preserves selected leading comments, and parses exported declarations and descriptive comment blocks to produce indexed API documentation for modules, procedures, constants, types, and variables. The script owns the high-level assembly of library manuals, including README inclusion, module discovery, output-format-specific markup, and single-file or whole-library generation.
